verdict.rationale: Gumloop is an agent-building platform, not a standalone coding agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Its docs only show client-side MCP: connecting agents to any MCP server, plus Hosted and Proxied MCPs for running or routing your own organization's servers. Nothing documents a first-party Gumloop MCP endpoint that external agents can connect to, and the probe's 'official MCP server' link points to the custom MCP client page, so it does not establish one.
